import pandas as pd

# Load the datasets
train_df = pd.read_csv('E:\\csv\\forest_fires_train.csv')
test_df = pd.read_csv('E:\\csv\\forest_fires_test.csv')

# Copy the DataFrames to ensure we don't modify the original data
train_df_copy = train_df.copy()
test_df_copy = test_df.copy()

# Display the first few rows of the datasets to understand the structure
print("Training Data:")
display(train_df_copy.head())
print("Test Data:")
display(test_df_copy.head())

# Check the data types of each column
print("Data types in Training Data:")
print(train_df_copy.dtypes)
print("Data types in Test Data:")
print(test_df_copy.dtypes)

from sklearn.preprocessing import LabelEncoder, StandardScaler

# Copy the datasets to avoid modifying the original data
train_df_processed = train_df_copy.copy()
test_df_processed = test_df_copy.copy()

# Handling missing values
train_df_processed.fillna(train_df_processed.median(), inplace=True)
test_df_processed.fillna(test_df_processed.median(), inplace=True)

# Encoding categorical variables
label_encoder = LabelEncoder()
for column in ['month', 'day']:
    train_df_processed[column] = label_encoder.fit_transform(train_df_processed[column])
    test_df_processed[column] = label_encoder.transform(test_df_processed[column])

# Scaling numerical features
scaler = StandardScaler()
numeric_features = ['X', 'Y', 'FFMC', 'DMC', 'DC', 'ISI', 'temp', 'RH', 'wind', 'rain']
train_df_processed[numeric_features] = scaler.fit_transform(train_df_processed[numeric_features])
test_df_processed[numeric_features] = scaler.transform(test_df_processed[numeric_features])

# Display the first few rows of the processed datasets
print("Processed Training Data:")
display(train_df_processed.head())
print("Processed Test Data:")
display(test_df_processed.head())

# Copy the datasets to avoid modifying the original data

test_df_processed = test_df_copy.copy()

# Handling missing values

test_df_processed.fillna(test_df_processed.mean(), inplace=True)

# Encoding categorical variables
label_encoder = LabelEncoder()
for column in ['month', 'day']:
    train_df_processed[column] = label_encoder.fit_transform(train_df_processed[column])
    test_df_processed[column] = label_encoder.transform(test_df_processed[column])

# Scaling numerical features

numeric_features = ['X', 'Y', 'FFMC', 'DMC', 'DC', 'ISI', 'temp', 'RH', 'wind', 'rain']
train_df_processed[numeric_features] = scaler.fit_transform(train_df_processed[numeric_features])
test_df_processed[numeric_features] = scaler.transform(test_df_processed[numeric_features])

# Display the first few rows of the processed data
print("Processed Training Data:")
display(train_df_processed.head())
print("Processed Test Data:")
display(test_df_processed.head())
